subject: Future Tech
title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Commonwealth Fusion Systems.

hook.text: Spun from MIT in 2018, Commonwealth Fusion raised over $2 billion to build the world's first compact fusion reactor.

buildup.text: Their secret weapon: HTS magnets that generate 20 tesla. Stronger magnets mean smaller reactors and lower costs.

discovery.text: SPARC, their demo reactor, aims to produce 140 MW of fusion from 25 MW of heating. Net energy by the late 2020s.

twist.text: SPARC is the size of a tennis court, not a stadium. If it works, compact fusion could be deployed like wind farms.

climax.text: ARC, the commercial follow-up, aims to sell electricity to the grid. CFS is the best-funded fusion startup on Earth.

punchline.text: MIT magnets, billions in funding, and a deadline.

quiz.question: What university did Commonwealth Fusion Systems spin out of?
